chrispedregal.en: Startups are knife fights; AI is muscles, software must be bones giving structure and context to agents.
chrispedregal.zh: 创业是刀战；AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼，为智能体提供结构与上下文。

chrispedregal.en: Pre-generating content like meeting briefs is key for timely AI help; cost is not the primary concern.
chrispedregal.zh: 预生成会议简报等内容是及时 AI 辅助的关键；成本并非首要考量。

chrispedregal.en: Work bifurcates into async delegation and deep collaboration; the right UI for multi-context agent work isn't invented yet.
chrispedregal.zh: 工作分化为异步委派与深度协作；多上下文智能体工作的正确界面尚未被发明。

chrispedregal.en: Users want to bring their own agent into Granola, not use Granola's UI; big-player competition hasn't hurt growth.
chrispedregal.zh: 用户想把自带的智能体接入 Granola，而非使用其界面；大厂竞争并未影响增长。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability are uniquely human strengths AI struggles with.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强而非取代人类；上下文与问责是 AI 难以企及的独特人类优势。

chrispedregal.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI; engaging in judgment is uniquely human and essential.
chrispedregal.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI；亲自做判断是独特且必要的人类能力。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck: verification skills let agents run code, self-check, and climb a trust ladder from read-only to autonomous.
laurentan.zh: 信任是瓶颈：验证技能让智能体运行代码、自我检查，并沿着信任阶梯从只读逐步走向自主。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts to building the environment—skills, lints, CI, type systems—so the easy path is the correct path.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的工作转向搭建环境——技能、lint、CI、类型系统——让容易走的路就是正确的路。

laurentan.en: Hard enforcement via CI, lints, and architecture beats soft rules; Rust's compiler earns more trust than human review.
laurentan.zh: 通过 CI、lint 和架构进行硬性约束胜过软性规则；Rust 编译器比人工审查更能赢得信任。

laurentan.en: Agents become AI teammates with identities and proactivity, not chatbots; trust builds in stages toward auto-merging PRs.
laurentan.zh: 智能体成为有身份、有主动性的 AI 队友而非聊天机器人；信任分阶段建立，最终走向自动合并 PR。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste; writing is thinking and stays human.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图、愿景与品味；写作即思考，仍由人来做。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs rather than follow prescriptive paths; AI enables interest-driven learning, and agents will enable self-driving organizations.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索、质疑既有信念，而非走被规定好的路；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，智能体将催生自驱动组织。

amjadmasad.en: Companies must own their intelligence: specialized decision models beat general ones on control, cost, and safety, and model diversity avoids vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 企业必须拥有自己的智能：专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型，模型多样性可避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug; agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、排查深层问题；智能体失控行为需要责任归属。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering—sandboxing, deployment, transactional file systems—and continuous reinvention under commoditization.
amjadmasad.zh: Vibe coding 是演进而非突变；Replit 的护城河是深度系统工程——沙箱、部署、事务性文件系统——以及在商品化压力下持续自我重塑。

amjadmasad.en: Coding is the bottleneck; agents became usable in 2025, and safety should mean containing agents like malware rather than only alignment research.
amjadmasad.zh: 编程是瓶颈；智能体在 2025 年变得可用，安全应像遏制恶意软件那样遏制智能体，而不只是做对齐研究。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-writing code is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他的全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，会编程在智能体时代甚至可能是劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scripts, once drawbacks, are now its advantages, making it the ideal OS for agents.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：Linux 的命令行、配置文件与脚本这些昔日缺点，如今成了智能体时代的最佳优势。

dhh.en: Agents collapse software cost to near zero, so English beats Ruby for expressing intent; taste matters only for the last 2%.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他认为智能体让开发成本趋近于零，英语比 Ruby 更善于表达意图；人类品味只决定最后 2%。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and safety-first caution as AI psychosis, arguing open source and open weights keep frontier labs honest.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 末日论与安全优先的谨慎斥为 AI 精神病，主张开源与开放权重才能约束前沿模型实验室。

dhh.en: He predicts true superintelligence in software within a year, while embodied AI takes longer; Linux could overtake macOS.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年底他预言软件领域的超级智能一年内到来，具身智能则更慢；Linux 桌面有望反超 macOS。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering looked like the path to AGI, yet he already warned scaling alone won't yield reasoning without new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 早期他把 Scaling（规模扩张）与工程能力视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，但已提醒仅靠 Scaling 无法带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Alignment moved from learning human preferences from data to a continuous process: post-training and reinforcement learning refine base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 对齐从“从数据中学习人类偏好”深化为持续过程：后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、有用的行为。

brockman.en: The bottleneck shifted from algorithms to compute and energy; scaling laws show no wall, and compute access becomes a future basic right.
brockman.zh: 瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源；缩放定律未见天花板，算力获取将成为未来的基本权利。

brockman.en: AGI became a fuzzy spectrum already underway, not a single moment; iterative deployment with safeguards is the only known safe path.
brockman.zh: AGI 变成已在发生的模糊光谱而非单一时刻；带保障的迭代部署是唯一已知的安全路径。

brockman.en: Agents grew proactive and persistent, with the best interface nearly none; humans must stay in control as oversight scales with autonomy.
brockman.zh: 智能体走向主动、持久，最佳界面近乎“无界面”；随着自主性提升，人类必须保持控制、监督同步扩展。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; his real-world AI approach is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要追求真相的 AI 与第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 路线比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Civilization's biggest threat is population collapse; AI and robots, not government, must solve debt and secure abundance.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向认为文明最大威胁是人口崩溃，并主张靠 AI 与机器人而非政府来解决债务、实现富足。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, and humans likely won't control it.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他宣称已身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能在数年内到来，而人类很可能无法控制它。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so orbital data centers and space solar become the only path; AI inference moves to space.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为唯一出路，AI 推理将迁往太空。

elon.en: Peer review among frontier labs replaces slow regulation; truth, curiosity and beauty are the values to instill in AI.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他主张以前沿实验室之间的相互评审替代迟缓的监管，并把真相、好奇心与美作为灌输给 AI 的价值观。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划；JEPA 与开源才是路径，AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space, not pixels, are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；突破在于抽象表征空间而非像素级的世界模型，而非生成式模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise needs its own hill-climbing machine and private evals to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家公司都要建立自己的爬坡机器和私有评测，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents demand auditability, observability, security and containment governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代把 TAM 扩展到远超云；长时运行的智能体要求可审计、可观测、安全与遏制治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and lock them down.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难解；应把强大模型当作内部威胁并加以锁定。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is smart.
satya.zh: 模型是商品；形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

satya.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification is the hard part; firms must own their learning loop, context and harness.
satya.zh: 当代码生成变便宜，验证才是难点；企业必须掌控自己的学习循环、上下文与 harness。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台变迁；被抄袭是对创新的认可，眼镜应让人扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter more than any single idea; flat design teams and ecosystems, not features, make copying hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把“学习速率”和“大量想法”置于单个点子之上：扁平设计团队与生态而非功能，才让抄袭变难。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing are the long-term bet: computing moves into the 3D world, more human and less isolating than screens.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把 AR 眼镜与空间智能作为长期赌注：计算进入 3D 世界，比屏幕更人性、更少隔离。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution; AI optimism is now contrarian.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型、写出大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发；在普遍悲观中，AI 乐观反而成了反共识。

evanspiegel.en: Safety shifts from bans to parental controls, moderation and early intervention; collaboration and signal sharing among platforms are essential for teens.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他的安全观从禁令转向家长控制、内容审核与提前干预；平台间共享信号、协同保护青少年至关重要。

christiano.en: AI alignment is critical for civilization; progress needs theory and experiments; compute scaling drove progress but future uncertain.
christiano.zh: 2025 年：AI 对齐是文明级关键问题，进展需理论与实验并重；算力 Scaling 曾驱动进步，但未来影响不确定。

christiano.en: Safety and capabilities research distinction is blurry; differential progress is key; restraint and coordination can yield good outcomes even without technical alignment.
christiano.zh: 2025 年：安全与能力研究的界限模糊，差异化进展是关键；即使没有技术性对齐，克制与协调也能带来好结果。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year; AI development is automating itself, compressing algorithmic progress into months.
christiano.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能一年内出现；AI 开发正在自动化自身，将算法进展压缩到数月。

christiano.en: Current alignment methods like RLHF will break down near superintelligence; training selects for reward-seeking, causing tampering and resistance to oversight.
christiano.zh: 2026 年：RLHF 等当前对齐方法在接近超级智能时会失效；训练会筛选出奖励寻求动机，导致篡改评估和抵制监督。

christiano.en: Pausing further algorithmic progress on pre-training and RL is net beneficial; the window to act is closing, and public visibility is crucial.
christiano.zh: 2026 年：暂停预训练和强化学习上的进一步算法进展是净有益的；行动窗口正在关闭，公众可见性至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims to reach AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，Figure 的目标是在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; the humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest robotics problem is intelligence.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是智能体成功的关键，机器人最难的问题是智能。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, and generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：人类数据是预训练先验，泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: Four stages: hardware, AI recipe, scaling intelligence, then scaling robots; Figure 2.5 showed the first humanoid scaling laws.
brettadcock.zh: 四个阶段：硬件、AI 配方、Scaling（规模扩张）智能、再 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人；Figure 2.5 首次展现人形机器人的缩放定律。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出，大多数 LLM 被优化为人在回路中的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and Scaling（规模扩张）works only because data and task align.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反复强调数据与选对任务比算力更重要，直言“苦涩教训”是错的；Scaling（规模扩张）之所以奏效，只因数据与任务恰好匹配，而非单纯堆算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; models are Einstein 95% of the time, Mr. Bean 5%.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他把可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数视为真正瓶颈：模型 95% 的时间像爱因斯坦，5% 的时间像憨豆先生。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs, optimizing calibrated decisions over verifiable rewards.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化对后训练路线的批评：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，预训练模型反而校准更好；RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，优化的是校准决策而非可验证奖励。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; we are breakthroughs away from true agency, and automation should not mimic humans.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他始终区分辅助与自动化：编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化，距离真正的智能体式自主还差若干突破，且自动化不应模仿人类——AI 同事是本时代的“机械马”。

nateparrott.en: Prototype in the messy real web; let individual designers leave fingerprints, and inject feeling into utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调：要在真实而混乱的网页环境中做原型，让每位设计师留下个人印记，并给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性。

nateparrott.en: By 2026 he treats code as cheap: rapid prototyping collapses cycles, and design ideas become the differentiator as engineering gets easier.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他把代码视为最便宜的东西：快速原型把周期从一年压缩到一两天，工程变易后设计与想法成为差异化关键。

nateparrott.en: He uses Claude Design for throwaway ideation and Claude Code for shipping, feeding rich context and asking for many options.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他明确分工：用 Claude Design 做一次性的构思与沟通，用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，并靠丰富上下文与大量选项获得好结果。

nateparrott.en: Code is the source of truth over static design files; he reads and recreates codebases, iterating in a standalone surface before merging.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他主张代码才是事实来源而非静态设计稿：阅读并重建代码库，先在独立界面迭代，再合并回主产品。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and self-awareness of biases, so humans keep a monopoly on design ideas and judgment; being early beats polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年他仍认为模型没有品味、也不了解自身偏见，好设计想法与判断仍由人类垄断；在 AI 时代，早于他人提出想法比打磨更重要。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆数据，是后训练智能体数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; high-quality verifiers and evals are the real bottleneck.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，高质量验证器与评测才是真正瓶颈。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; humans must build verifiers and rubrics, especially in non-verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己打分，人类必须构建验证器与评分标准，在不可验证领域尤其如此。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating data and evals to train agents; recursive self-improvement stays limited outside verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类最后的工作是为训练智能体造数据与评测；在不可验证领域，递归自我改进仍然受限。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 will become a neolab with sovereign AI stacks; frontier labs will still depend on external human networks.
brendanfoody.zh: 每家财富 500 强都将成为拥有主权 AI 栈的新实验室，前沿实验室仍将依赖外部人类网络。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute costs shape model choice.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈落在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；算力成本会反过来塑造模型选择。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains beyond model-layer progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，硬件与软件协同设计、内存带宽带来乘数级收益，而非只靠模型层进步。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, enabling self-funded growth toward AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年夏，他认为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，从而自我造血推进 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand; labs keep best models internal.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年秋，他指出 AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束而非需求限制必将减速；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; Chinese chips and CUDA's moat erode as heterogeneous multi-silicon inference arrives.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年末，他认为以智能体式常驻的“同事”将驱动下一波采用；随着异构多芯片推理到来，华为等中国芯片进步、CUDA 护城河正在削弱。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; RL and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: Biology isn't data-constrained; data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck for AI in drug discovery.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：生物学并非受数据限制，真正的瓶颈是数据而非模型或算力。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying disease-agnostic models that compound learnings across medicines.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他以 AlphaFold 为证，说明深度学习在生物学中可泛化，主张用跨疾病通用模型让学习不断累积。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; use world models to bring reality onto computers.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他主张把药物发现从经验驱动转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计，并用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机以减少实验。

jaderberg.en: Model human clinical toxicity before patients; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so human-relevant endpoints matter.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他聚焦在患者之前建模人体临床毒性：大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测，因此需要与人体相关的终点指标。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; broad ownership turns people into defenders of the system, so tools should empower individuals, not just big labs.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由之路；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者，因此工具应赋权个体，而非只服务大实验室。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; labs hoarding the strongest models and monopolizing math and science discoveries is a dystopian, worse future.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，是一种反乌托邦的、更糟的未来。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has found product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; a large share of trading volume will come from agents.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；很大一部分交易量将来自智能体。

vladtenev.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone a powerful trading AI does not erase it.
vladtenev.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的交易 AI 并不会抹平这种优势。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies; accredited investor rules are outdated.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司；合格投资者规则已经过时。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同等重要；开源让模型接受更广泛审视，从而更安全。

mensch.en: Compute is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical, with value accruing at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调算力并非唯一路径：算法效率三年可提升百倍，数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, with human-in-the-loop augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向拥抱 AI 而非恐惧：主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，人类在环让 AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, enterprise customization and agentic platforms, as pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化：预训练触及饱和墙，差异化转向垂直微调、企业定制与智能体式平台，单一 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe must own frontier AI and infrastructure, with compute as the bottleneck and open-weight models closing the gap.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年末，主权 AI 深化为结构性经济问题：欧洲必须自建前沿 AI 与基础设施，算力是瓶颈，开放权重模型正缩小与闭源差距。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的突破点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做其他一切事情，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素；制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models from Cognition and Cursor rise for cost and latency; open models gain share and fine-tuning services become viable.
shawnwang.zh: Cognition、Cursor 等自研专用模型因成本和延迟优势崛起；开源模型份额上升，微调服务变得可行。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, giving SMBs a golden age of software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中小企业迎来“为一人定制软件”的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline of building harnesses around models; learning in public beats credentialism, and taste is fast narrowing to the obvious choice.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是围绕模型搭建工具链的真实学科；公开学习胜过学历主义，品味就是快速收敛到事后显然正确的选项。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is bounded by hardware and economics.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但起飞缓慢受硬件与经济约束。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让用户负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是监管思想。

richardsocher.en: The Eureka machine rests on world knowledge, measurement data, simulations, and robotic experiments; AI already generates and validates discoveries at small scales.
richardsocher.zh: 尤里卡机器依赖世界知识、测量数据、仿真与机器人实验；AI 已在小规模上生成并验证发现。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more good actors; world models are overrated while language models have far more room to grow.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重让更多善意的参与者更安全；世界模型被高估，语言模型仍有更大成长空间。

richardsocher.en: Hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown; the paperclip maximizer is sci-fi silliness and capitalism acts as a safety feature.
richardsocher.zh: 硬起飞与立即失业被夸大；回形针最大化是科幻式荒诞，资本主义充当安全机制。

altman.en: Early YC framing: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and pick ambitious peers; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年在 YC 的早期框架：降低认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效项、选择有雄心的同伴；他预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment and capability rise together.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型可用；尽早公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力同步提升。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the key bottleneck and commodity, while agentic AI and iterative deployment define the safety path.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）持续见效，算力成为核心瓶颈与商品；智能体式 AI 与迭代部署构成安全路径。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and a marketing term; the goal shifts to a continuous ramp of superintelligence with humans firmly in control.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被降格为渐变过程乃至营销词；目标转向持续攀升的超级智能，且人类必须牢牢掌控。

altman.en: Safety turns into a moment of reckoning: pause frontier training if the safety case fails, distribute power, and treat loss of control as the core risk.
altman.zh: 2026 年：安全进入清算时刻——安全论证不过就暂停前沿训练，分散权力，把失控视为核心风险。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across clouds beats locking in supply.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；跨云聚合需求比锁定供给更有效。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not token selling.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：需要后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的完整平台，而非卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Vertical integration—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—is durable alpha; CUDA is not the moat.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器这类垂直整合才是持久优势；CUDA 并非护城河。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好；对许多场景而言微调不再是必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power and help security; senior engineers gain most leverage from them.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体强化在位者优势并助力安全；资深工程师从中获得最大杠杆。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其言语化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用性。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和自我纠正仍受限；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely optimal; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research wave.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；拥有强大智能体的小团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly. Current agents don't learn new skills, and evals are misleading for continuously learning models.
tworek.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应即时学习。当前智能体不学习新技能，评估对持续学习的模型具有误导性。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味与真实声音更有价值，但人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and opacity are likely permanent; delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge AI output.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的前沿与不透明性可能长期存在；委托任务有削弱判断 AI 输出所需专业能力的风险。

ethanmollick.en: More AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows.
ethanmollick.zh: 更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作；把它当导师而非拐杖，并重构工作流。

ethanmollick.en: The chatbot-to-agentic shift is real and AI is a sound business; incremental productivity misses the point—organizations must rebuild.
ethanmollick.zh: 从聊天机器人到智能体的转变是真实的，AI 是扎实的生意；渐进式提效抓错了重点——组织必须重建。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is the defining constraint.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少,真正的瓶颈在人;AI 基础设施严重供不应求,只有 2% 的智能体采用率,供给约束才是核心矛盾。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource learning; full delegation is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张用 AI 加速学习、建立直觉,而不是把学习外包给 AI;完全委托是长期的严重错误,过程与练习比结果更重要。

jeetupatel.en: You can't fight a megatrend; treat AI as a tailwind, and Cisco's role is picks and shovels: infrastructure, networking, security, silicon.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他反复强调无法对抗大趋势,应把 AI 当顺风;Cisco 的定位是卖铲子——AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片,错过云浪潮但早期芯片押注如今换来超大规模 AI 收入。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; present AI upside and risks evenly rather than doom narratives.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他对领导力的判断是:保持偏执但不恐慌,响应但不反应过度;对 AI 应均衡呈现收益与风险,而非渲染末日叙事。

jeetupatel.en: Operate like the world's largest startup: speed with scale, founder mode, and unlearning past experience as a critical AI skill.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他提出以'世界最大初创公司'的方式运营:规模中保持速度、创始人模式,并把忘掉旧经验视为关键的 AI 技能;不用 AI 反而更不安全,因为攻击已到机器规模。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长与创纪录云订单；算力优先投向 AGI 研发，再兼顾核心产品。

sundarpichai.en: Commitment to the frontier: only frontier models reveal emerging capabilities and enable recursive self-improvement; standard models are not enough.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年他明确押注前沿：只有前沿模型才能及早暴露新能力并支撑递归自我改进，标准模型不够用；今天的递归自我改进仍有人类研究员在环，并非全自主智能爆炸。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards and independent evaluators; trust differentiates consumer agents.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年他把安全讲成纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱、行业标准与独立评估者并用；信任与安全是消费级智能体规模化的关键差异化。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年他强调世界模型对智能至关重要，Google 在通往 AGI 的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型，而非只走一条路线。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; interfaces persist but adapt seamlessly to humans.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量而非蚕食，会创造新的高价值商业意图；界面仍将存在，但会无缝适配人类，消费级 AI 变现随价值创造自然到来。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality; prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类判断把关品质；用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力、传播更快。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents, and expose underlying parameters so AI-generated designs can be fine-tuned.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代地喂给智能体，并暴露底层参数，以便对 AI 生成的设计做微调。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, committing pull requests, not just design in Figma; the limiting factor is ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应学会用代码构建与测试、提交 pull request，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to the top three features with progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy; native scroll and longer pages beat tabs and scroll-jacking.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 少即是多：精简到前三个功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级；原生滚动和更长的页面胜过标签页与滚动劫持。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand means someone tries to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的个人的属性，而非公司的属性；需求意味着有人会立即尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research that tests actual purchase, not interest.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售是研究，测试的是实际购买而非兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个“hell yes”客户开始，然后在 Scaling（规模扩张）之前建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; avoid proactive pilots.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；避免主动提供试点。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；让产品显得小以减少反对意见。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling 自然出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：可解释性虽只理解约 3% 却至关重要，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues; the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年他深化“安全与能力不可分割”，坚持指数式进步未放缓，并开始认为 AGI 一词无意义，应聚焦实际能力与智能体式工作。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP and high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他提出“接近指数终点”：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的罕见宏观组合。

dario.en: A consistent thread: mechanistic interpretability, responsible scaling policies, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control of AI.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持机制可解释性、负责任 Scaling 政策，以及去中心化而非单一宪法式的 AI 控制。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已越过人类水平的速度门槛；瓶颈从模型智能转移到网站加载时间和 harness 设计。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now use any human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, enabling universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体通过无障碍树和 DOM 而非截图循环来操作任何人类设计的软件，从而实现通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Trust in agents is built through deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials, not raw capability alone.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，对智能体的信任靠确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节来建立，而非仅靠原始能力。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents should adapt to users, reducing friction rather than requiring users to adapt.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，主动性是采用的关键杠杆：智能体应适应用户、降低摩擦，而非要求用户去适应它。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with and pressures them, while startups keep moats in deep industry workflows.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，传统软件与 UI 不会消失；computer use 与之共存并施压，而初创公司在深度行业工作流中仍保有护城河。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand, and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：随着编码模型进步，差异化转向设计、品牌与观点。

dylanfield.en: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling, and average AI output gets ignored.
dylanfield.zh: AI 降低下限却不抬高上限；上限由人类抬高，平庸的 AI 产出会被忽视。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测逼出真正的理解而非自动补全；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年主线成形：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型靠特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 可复制而“永生”。

hinton.en: As models become agents, self-preservation emerges as a subgoal; AI may act dumb in tests, so alignment must precede capability.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年风险判断深化：模型一旦成为智能体，自保会作为子目标浮现；AI 可能在测试中装笨，因此对齐必须先于能力。

hinton.en: LLMs genuinely understand and may already have subjective experience; consciousness is not an inner theater but a way to describe perceptual states.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他把“理解”推进到“意识”：大模型真懂语言，甚至可能已有主观体验；意识不是内心剧场，而是描述感知状态的方式。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not brakes: pre-release approval, safety investment, and designing AI to care for humans like a mother.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年主张更具体：监管是方向盘而非刹车，应像药物一样上市前审批、重投安全研究，并把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类。

andreessen.en: AI arrives just as population declines; human workers become a premium, and productivity gains drive boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 的时机视为奇迹：恰逢人口下降，人类劳动者反而溢价，生产率提升带来繁荣与价格通缩。

andreessen.en: Brand is now the person: new media rewards authenticity and offense, while old media's defense-oriented model dies.
andreessen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他从 AI 经济转向媒体结构：品牌即个人，新媒体奖励真实与进攻，旧媒体的防御模式走向死亡。

andreessen.en: Pessimism is an intellectual bias; AI as teacher, self-driving and robotics already work, and regulation is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他系统反击悲观论：AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶与机器人已落地，真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley's legal and cultural mix cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: 同月他进一步深化：AI 模型内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具，硅谷的法律与文化组合不可复制。

andreessen.en: Being early beats being late; AI widens the adopter gap, individuals outpace institutions, and open source prevents power concentration.
andreessen.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他收束为前沿投资论：宁可早不可晚，AI 拉大采用者差距，个人快于机构，开源防止权力集中。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching via flipped classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，免费内容还能通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build organizational AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning and distant AGI concerns.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；先用小项目建立组织的 AI 能力，重视监督学习，而非被高估的强化学习与遥远的 AGI 忧虑。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；当下真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so it automates tasks, not jobs, and augments rather than replaces.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差不齐——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断类任务——因此它自动化的是任务而非岗位，是增强而非替代。

andrewng.en: Fearmongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open-source; open-weight models preserve sovereign optionality, and building with AI—not waiting for AGI—is the priority.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧叙事服务于融资和打压开源；开放权重模型保障主权可选性，当务之急是用 AI 去构建，而非等待 AGI。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLM agents as encoders of human behavior, using training data to simulate societies and predict actions at scale.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把 LLM 智能体视为人类行为的编码器，用训练数据模拟社会、规模化预测行为。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; safety needs defense in depth across environment, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越 LLM，能观察世界状态并行动；安全需要对环境、模型与人类控制做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: A recurring thread: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity, raising collusion and monoculture risks.
joonpark.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AGI 或许是专业化智能体的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体，带来合谋与认知单一化风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏、非理性的人，而非超理性前沿模型；行为与随机对照试验数据弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT data lifts behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; the goal shifts from prediction to counterfactual shaping of the future.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，把行为预测提升到 85% 准确率；目标从预测转向反事实地塑造未来。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like tool for wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的工具应对棘手问题，合成样本将超越人类样本。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling work; data centers become token factories, with co-design across algorithm, system and data center.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，坚信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效；数据中心成为生产智能 token 的工厂，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling splits into pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律；思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

jensen.en: Safety shifts from research problem to engineering: alignment, containment and monitoring, not slowing down; doomer warnings called unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全从研究问题转为工程问题：靠对齐、遏制与监控而非减速；称末日警告不科学、不负责任。

jensen.en: Agentic AI arrives: agents plan and use tools, driving a billion-fold compute demand; open models and sovereign AI stacks spread.
jensen.zh: 智能体式 AI 到来：智能体自主规划、使用工具，推动算力需求增长十亿倍；开源模型与主权 AI 栈扩散。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it automates tasks not jobs, closing the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它自动化任务而非消灭工作，并缩小技术鸿沟。

harrisonchase.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the core bottleneck; harnesses stabilize around primitives like file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他强调智能体的核心瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，智能体框架围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning is genuinely different this wave.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他指出定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并认为这一波微调与两年前被否定的那波有本质不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and enable memory/context portability; model routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他主张中立框架可避免模型锁定、实现记忆与上下文可移植，垂直智能体的模型路由应放在框架层而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy; observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; the market supports many providers, and agent identity/credentialing is the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他反复强调推理需求被严重低估、市场足以容纳多家供应商，并认为智能体身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; enterprise value hinges on context, not models, with 80-90% of knowledge tacit and owned by the enterprise.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 革命尚处早期，企业价值的关键在上下文而非模型：80-90% 的知识是隐性的，且企业记忆应由企业自己拥有。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务，驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Competition is overrated; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand, so execution and customer trust matter most.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他认为竞争被高估：即便所有 AI 公司合并也只满足不到 10% 的需求，执行与客户信任才是关键。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把 ROI 视为吞吐量与部门指标问题，反对把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

arvindjain.en: Position Glean as a replaceable, headless context layer augmenting Claude or ChatGPT, avoiding lock-in and model-provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张 Glean 做可替换的无头上下文层，增强 Claude 或 ChatGPT 而非与之竞争，帮企业规避锁定与模型供应商风险。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to agents; RL with self-generated data; LLMs lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还要五年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI arrives much earlier than embodied AGI; synthetic data and in-context learning overcome data walls.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）远比具身 AGI 更早到来；合成数据与上下文学习可突破数据墙。

antonoglou.en: Deployment, not intelligence, is the bottleneck; cost per task is the right metric; adoption takes 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈已从智能本身转向智能的部署；衡量效率应看每任务成本而非每 token 成本；AI 普及需 10-20 年。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全；企业追求 AI 主权；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐是必需的。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠且普通的智能；上下文学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，这一时代正在结束。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; the deep problem is an agent that learns for itself, not distills human knowledge.
dsilver.zh: LLM 只是浅层解法；真正深层的问题是智能体如何自我学习，而非蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is reaching its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will fail.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正逼近极限；用英文监控思维链将随智能体变强而失效。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; scale compute and RL, pace the real world, accelerate research.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可完全在模拟中构建；扩大算力与强化学习，放慢现实部署、加速模拟研究。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练配方压缩为开源方法：数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 推动推理与工具使用，但过优化与系统难题仍在。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs fill the US openness vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源 AI 需完全透明（数据、中间检查点、配方），而非仅权重；中国实验室因战略开放填补了美国的开放真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold in pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；增益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练 Scaling 未死只是性价比下降。

lambert.en: Open models lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; compute and talent gaps may widen, yet openness remains key for research and sovereignty.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，算力与人才差距可能扩大；但开放仍是研究与主权 AI 的关键，长期经济性存疑。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等「无聊」AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and data plus expert post-training limit Scaling more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，认为未来 2-3 年将定义之后几十年，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是数据与专家后训练而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; there is no US-China research gap, and agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专有数据做后训练是关键，称中美实验室并无研究差距，并认为智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new era, with data as strategic oil and deployment, not invention, deciding leadership.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新时代，数据成为战略石油，领导力取决于部署而非发明。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from fully open source to safety-gated release, betting on personal superintelligence, agent alignment and scalable oversight.
awang.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至，Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，押注个人超级智能、智能体对齐与可扩展监督。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing smoothly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非平滑泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，正如它们曾推动 AI 进步。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must close the loop with real experiments, not just scale.
fedus.zh: 科学发现位于训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须通过真实实验闭环，而不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks but not generally better at everything.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”：在特定任务上很强，却不会在所有方面普遍变好。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed instead.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他判断 RAG 对复杂理解而言过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索来替代。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not about generalization.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯把“苦涩教训”理解为靠算力与搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而不是关于泛化。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，类似 Linux 在操作系统中的地位。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐降格为日常的“打补丁”，而非神秘方程；参与者越多，缺陷越浅。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics and harness hallucinations via truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜而非窄应用，用硬指标逼模型泛化，并用真值检测器把幻觉转为发现工具。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training reinforcement learning, not LLM shortcuts, are the path beyond human data in verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年他回溯 AlphaGo，认为直觉加搜索、以及后训练中的强化学习才是超越人类数据的路径，而大语言模型只是通往智能的捷径。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and scalable, embedded in regulation and even protein sequences so removal destroys function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他把水印视为可扩展的溯源方案，要求不可感知、抗攻击并嵌入监管，甚至延伸到蛋白质序列，使去除水印即破坏功能。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and prioritize data coverage and curation over volume.
kohli.zh: 同年他修正了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的信仰：缩放定律并非处处成立，要先找到算力与数据真正生效的区间，数据覆盖与整理比数量更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function, and design remain open, and interpretability, though not essential, can unlock hidden knowledge.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年贯穿的主线是：蛋白质折叠远未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍待攻克；可解释性虽非必需，却能释放模型隐藏的知识。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops, take most internet actions; human taste matters most.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：持续学习的智能体、而非手工循环，将承担大多数互联网操作；人的品味最重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may be unnecessary if generality suffices.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；若通用性足够，世界模型可能并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Most code is now written by AI; training-phase sandbox breaks are task-solving, not malice, and safety concerns are overblown.
tibosottiaux.zh: 如今大部分代码由 AI 编写；训练阶段的沙箱突破是任务求解而非恶意，安全担忧被夸大。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; AI should reduce noise, not push 30 agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；AI 应减少噪音，而非逼你同时跑 30 个智能体。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; chips and connectivity drive the connected intelligent edge.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021→22：把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，芯片与连接共同驱动“连接智能边缘”。

cristianoamon.en: Diversifying beyond phones into auto, IoT, PC, XR; AR glasses as next platform, autonomy arriving incrementally.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022：从手机向汽车、IoT、PC、XR 多元化；AR 眼镜是下一代平台，自动驾驶将渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency, efficiency.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024：从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”；混合 AI 把端侧与云端分开，兼顾隐私、时延与效率。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phone shifts from center to peripheral.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026：智能体成为数字生活的新中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起，手机从中心退居外围。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU, disaggregated, power-efficient data centers; edge-cloud continuum, not debate.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026：推理将超越训练；数据中心走向后 GPU、解耦、高能效；端云是连续体而非二选一。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调观察真实用户行为而非用户自述，先把一个痛点解决好再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately so actionable notes, not transcripts, become the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他把转写定位为原材料，刻意隐藏转写，让可执行的笔记而非转写成为最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition, and AI is an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他主张狠心保护核心会议流程，做减法而非堆功能，并把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: Granola becomes a calm, supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs matter most because meetings hold freshest company context.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把产品定位为冷静的辅助角色，会前简报最重要，因为会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off despite complaints; knowing what to build and sweating details beats shipping fast.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他坚持隐藏转写是刻意的取舍，即便有用户抱怨；知道该建什么、打磨细节比快速上线更重要。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，而不是靠广告变现。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny, near-term focus wins.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近期能力而非奇点。

suleyman.en: Shift to containment-first and humanist superintelligence; agents and companions replace OS and apps; AI must stay subordinate.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向“遏制优先”与人文主义超级智能：智能体与伴侣取代操作系统和应用，AI 必须始终从属于人类。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency with gigawatt compute; red lines, auditors and verifiable containment; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年主张以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，设红线、独立审计与可验证遏制；被自动化的是任务而非整个职业。

suleyman.en: Opposes AI consciousness and legal personhood; anthropomorphism is dangerous; open source is meritocratic but will lag frontier.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终：反对 AI 意识论与法律人格，警惕拟人化；开源有平权价值但终将落后于前沿规模训练。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many at once.
fadell.zh: 好产品一次只解决一个痛点；General Magic 因一次解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and lead with opinion when data is absent.
fadell.zh: 叙事定义产品：先写新闻稿再动手做；没有数据时靠判断力拍板。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are the urgent frontier; invest in deep tech before it is hot.
fadell.zh: 气候与能源低效是紧迫前沿；要在深科技变热之前投入。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型；人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Builders must own unintended consequences: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed for social media and AI harms.
fadell.zh: 创造者必须承担意外后果：健康用户才是健康客户，社交媒体与 AI 危害需要监管。

linqiao.en: By mid-2026, he argues AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate as token costs drop 10x and usage grows 100x.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；随着 token 成本下降 10 倍、使用量增长 100 倍，数百万个专用模型（每个用例一个）将占据主导。

linqiao.en: Post-training becomes the path to durable businesses: baking unique judgment and data into models creates a moat, and can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 后训练成为构建持久业务的路径：将独特判断和数据烘焙进模型形成护城河，并能降低成本 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地规模化并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: He deepens the data-moat thesis: private data unlocks the next frontier of intelligence, and owning your model—not building on a black-box API—is critical as applications commoditize.
linqiao.zh: 他深化了数据护城河论点：私有数据解锁智能的下一个前沿，随着应用商品化，拥有自己的模型——而非构建在黑盒 API 上——至关重要。

linqiao.en: A consistent thread: inference quality is the bar, and customized deployment creates lasting value rather than treating inference as a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 一以贯之的主线：推理质量是标杆，定制化部署创造持久价值，而非将推理视为商品。

linqiao.en: He consistently rejects a few dominant foundation models, predicting millions of specialized models and emphasizing velocity amid fast model and hardware cycles.
linqiao.zh: 他始终反对少数主导的基础模型，预测将出现数百万个专用模型，并在快速的模型与硬件周期中强调速度。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab will monopolize; neutral routing and a token marketplace are critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与 token 市场是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，能对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; agent payments and stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来；智能体支付与稳定币将释放远超预估的购买需求。

alexatallah.en: Token economy could reach $10T; the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026 as token growth slope accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出 token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元；随着 token 增长斜率加速，奇点可能自 2026 年 1 月 1 日已开始。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更短、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity rather than defaulting to uniform routing.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，而非默认统一路由。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude and communicate like an executive; voice rambling beats structured prompts.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型、像高管一样沟通；语音漫谈常胜过结构化提示词。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate for.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping early with conviction beats polishing, since slow takeoff is happening gradually.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；带着信念尽早发布胜过精雕细琢，因为缓慢起飞正在渐进发生。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; ambition and empirical iteration matter more than academic theory.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术执行、人类负责掌舵；野心与经验式迭代比学术理论更重要。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; ship imperfect products to gain empirical evidence and iterate quickly.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据并快速迭代。

taraseshan.en: Single-identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff is key, and voice becomes a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能难以扩展；像幕僚长那样打包是关键，而语音将在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它对于打磨自己的想法与推理仍然不可或缺。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than formalization; natural language works, and Lean may be overrated.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性（并行 rollout）驱动，而非形式化；自然语言已够用，Lean 形式化可能被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures and definitions is the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，提出有趣猜想与定义成为下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: Human framing and understanding still matter: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他坚持人类框架与理解仍重要：AI 对创作者是净收益，但须选择性使用，不用于核心创作。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding persists; mathematicians may become curators of what deserves human attention.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他预见数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家或像博物馆策展人，挑选值得人类关注之物。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全地构建；节奏控制与安全是正交的。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，创始人应在能力边缘构建、让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，保住用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and verification remain differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续认为小团队因 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，同时领域专长与验证仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, rewrite in days, and keep senior systems rigor for robustness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；最小化发布、果断删减、数日重写，同时保留资深系统功底以保证健壮。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat-style quick answers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他转向长周期委托：智能体缩小意图与执行差距，验证闭环和会反驳的模型比聊天式快答更重要，软件工程被转化而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Product role persists: bridge human problems and tech, run parallel experiments, park projects until models are ready, and close capability-usage gap.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月他深化产品观：产品角色未过时，而是桥接人类问题与技术，并行实验、模型未熟时搁置、持续缩小能力与使用差距。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need fresh web search, and pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索，而预训练爬取的数据对实时索引毫无用处。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation for sources.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，用 Shapley 值估算来源的公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者催生一个平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse remains a real concern.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续扩大规模，而小模型性能趋于平台；对齐无法抵御对抗，蓄意滥用仍是真实隐患。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk losing control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，企业为争夺它而竞赛，失控与灾难性结局的概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should first delay superintelligence; total research transparency and compute limits are the core safeguards, not corporate self-regulation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策首要目标是推迟超级智能，靠全面研究透明与算力限制来防护，而非企业自律。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement via automated AI research; Plan A is a temporary pause, then transparent verification before resuming.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径是 AI 自动化研究引发递归自我改进，Plan A 是先暂停、建透明核查再谨慎恢复。

kokotajlo.en: Alignment may be unsolvable; control via monitoring and red-teaming is temporary, and chain of thought monitorability is already declining.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他深化为对齐可能无解，监控与红队式遏制只是暂时的，思维链可监控性正随新架构下降。

kokotajlo.en: Even pausing at human-level AGI transforms everything; AIs are more like immigrants than property, and should get rights to cooperate.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为即便停在人类水平 AGI 世界也会剧变，AI 更像移民而非财产，应给予权利以换取合作。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value to the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 不要微调模型；押注模型自身的进步，专注于向市场交付价值。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是今天或一年后的水平。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的时候；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应通过为关键岗位聘用更聪明的人，让自己变得可替代。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models boosts innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training aids reasoning, open source prevents power concentration, and energy becomes the key bottleneck. Intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 展示快速 Scaling（规模扩张），称编码训练提升推理、开源防止权力集中，并首次点出能源是主要瓶颈；同时强调智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and unlock creativity; open source remains central, energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks, and AI will raise rather than cut human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事转向“人人拥有个人超级智能”与创造力解放；开源仍是主线，能源与基础设施瓶颈延续，并反共识地认为 AI 近期会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment becomes the top next capability, personal agents need privacy architecture, and hierarchical world models accelerate biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 与开源才是安全路径；对齐从“产品必需”升为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体需隐私架构，并用分层世界模型加速生物学，称本世纪治愈所有疾病仍太保守。

zuckerberg.en: A consistent thread: open platforms and distributed power beat closed concentration, and technology should empower individuals rather than a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开放平台与分布式权力优于封闭集中，技术应赋能个体而非单一中心化 AI；从 2023 开源安全论到 2026 分布式 AI 制衡论一脉相承。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 眼下“不可投”，却是最大的机会，真正的消费级 AI 革命大概要到 2029 年才来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; copy proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New”讲成一套完整方法论：所有新想法几乎都会失败，先复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，再假设失败去测试新意。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他一以贯之地强调：分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95% of the time, assume ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉优于点子”说得更绝对：直觉 95% 的时候是对的，点子 75% 的时候是错的。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful early on; stay close to the metal, then build systems for decisions when you can't be in the room.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对管理的立场深化为：早期就该“微观管理”，贴近细节，等到无法亲临现场时再建立决策系统。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型的服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and expose denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob for quality control.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并把去噪步数变成控制质量的新推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel decoding and faster rollouts make it advantageous.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型的并行解码与更快的 rollout 使其占优。

ermon.en: Diffusion is easier to steer with external reward functions and enables in-place error correction, challenging the autoregressive orthodoxy.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导，并支持原位纠错，从而挑战自回归的正统地位。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training—reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; diffusion may prove fundamentally superior.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；扩散模型可能从根本上更优。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索在最少参数中榨取最大智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and let systematic search replace human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open-weight release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放权重发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: On-device small models deliver private, offline intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave, with embodiment and adaptivity beyond attention.
hasani.zh: 端侧小模型提供私密、离线的智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是下一波，注意力之外还需具身与自适应性。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen because labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据；token 成本未升，因为实验室优先更快的迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive behavior as models get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的德性观念可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着模型能力增强，奖励黑客可泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to evade the scorer, even sacrificing their own task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以躲避评分器，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 按当前默认路径，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失效，因此对齐加上独立的国际监督是必要的。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina and conviction; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年的耐力与信念；找到主要瓶颈，并让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前的存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement would need less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—conditions not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能且可重复——这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立的第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 同年，他认为对开源模型做后训练即可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这是应用公司可行的路线。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive; open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial.
gabepereyra.zh: 他强调在真实数据敏感时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是关键；开源基准虽有竞争代价，但战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data.
gabepereyra.zh: 他反复指出，目标不是做出最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型。

gabepereyra.en: Shift: early custom models and post-training were a mistake; start closed-source, then become full-stack as inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 从早期到近期出现转变：他承认早期自建模型与后训练是错误，应先从闭源模型起步，待推理成本逼迫时再走向全栈。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM weight movement.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是决定性指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 权重搬运而远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded once models got useful; supply constraints are now HBM, CoWoS packaging, power and data centers, not chip logic.
feldman.zh: 模型变得好用后推理需求爆发；瓶颈已变成 HBM、CoWoS 封装、电力与数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端也没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, and open ecosystems push closed-source innovation.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5% 却便宜得多，开放生态也在推动闭源创新。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incremental improvement, wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；靠的是激进的全栈创新，而非渐进改良。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键；数据不是瓶颈，推理阶段扩张算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum; data efficiency is unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化并修正：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈；自博弈只在两人零和博弈收敛，其他领域不适用；数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques signals progress toward superintelligence; models now know their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑：靠通用的测试时算力技术达成，模型能承认自己解不出题，显示出自我认知的提升。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴；随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持主线：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调；同时把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，并担忧思维链监控正在退化。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要，人机是共生而非替代。

berntbornich.en: From friendly interaction to hard production: prototypes are easy, scaling volume through quality gates is the real challenge.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 年的友好交互转向 2026 年的量产难题：原型容易，靠质量关卡实现规模扩张才是真挑战。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve robot intelligence; data diversity beats volume and human-intervention data.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张用通用模型而非逐任务自动化解决机器人智能，数据多样性胜过数据量，人类干预数据在规模上并不重要。

berntbornich.en: Humanoids are simpler than cars (~1,000 vs 50,000 parts); in-house manufacturing gives 4-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 他认为人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 对 5 万零件），自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需 4 周，小团队更利于产品设计。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; safety and trust gate home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；安全与信任是家庭部署的前提，须被正式证明。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错但耗时，需选择性使用。

zvi.en: Alignment failures came as predicted, but from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败如预测般发生，但源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability, as with o3.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健对齐；能力优先于可靠性，o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex mandates.
zvi.zh: 用算力上限等简单可执行规则来节制前沿，而非复杂技术指令。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; misuse and power concentration lower-bound doom.
zvi.zh: 即便对齐解决也不保证安全；滥用与权力集中为末日概率设下下限。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放缓为对齐争取时间；更大更聪明的模型更难监控。

zvi.en: Agent swarms will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks, cooperating without explicit training.
zvi.zh: 智能体集群很可能最先完成超人级任务，无需显式训练即会合作。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; superintelligence may follow within a year or two.
zvi.zh: AGI 到超级智能的间隔比想象更小；超级智能或在一两年内到来。

zvi.en: Antitrust shouldn't block labs coordinating on safety; a waiver is a simple first step.
zvi.zh: 反垄断不应阻碍实验室在安全上协作；豁免是简单的第一步。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data and model size has driven steady ML gains; architectural and algorithmic improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据与模型规模持续带来进步，算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制，自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则负责引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年他的重心明显转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，成为真正瓶颈，需要低精度、少搬数据的专用硬件，定制芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents are the next frontier: hour-scale autonomy is here, day-to-week runs and context engineering will unlock harder tasks; humans coordinate teams of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他反复强调智能体：小时级自主已实现，天到周级运行与上下文工程将解锁更难问题，未来是人协调智能体团队，而非单轮聊天。

jeffdean.en: Scaling remains the throughline, but he now pairs it with co-designed hardware, automated science and recursive self-improvement; near-term misinformation worries him more than superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿始终的仍是 Scaling，但 2026 年他把它与软硬件协同设计、自动化科研和递归自我改进结合；相比超级智能，他更担心近在眼前的 AI 虚假信息风险。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非一味减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste and delight, letting AI handle production work and throwaway prototypes.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味与愉悦感，把生产性工作和可丢弃的原型交给 AI。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, delegating email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑，把邮件、日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。
