johnbai.en: High-fidelity design means every idea backed by a working prototype, not static mockups; engineers can build successful first versions.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他把高保真设计定义为每个想法都有可运行原型而非静态稿，并认可工程师能做出成功的初版。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but fall short of AGI; true AI must master the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是对人类知识的索引，远未达到 AGI；真正的 AI 必须掌握物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs embodied robots and world models, not just software; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型，而不只是软件；大语言模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的；AI 会设定自己的目标，对安全的担忧被夸大了。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等待会带来更便宜的算力，开源也将迎头赶上。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems; self-replicating robots will build a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 的意识和痛感早在早期系统中就已出现；自我复制的机器人将建立新文明。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but AGI also needs new breakthroughs and world models.
demis.zh: 2025 年坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但 AGI 还需新突破与世界模型。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone insufficient, yet LLMs remain a key component.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，但 LLM 仍是关键组件。

demis.en: Safety as a collective action problem: from early warnings to government regulation and international governance.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全是集体行动问题，从早期预警逐步深化为政府监管与国际治理。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作去释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should master prompting and prototyping, balancing lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张设计师掌握提示与原型，兼顾降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律、让模型主导，产品保持轻触。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains needed for hard trade-offs and direction, even as models and AI shift the design role.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持，即便模型与 AI 改变设计角色，艰难取舍与方向对齐仍需人类领导。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型描述为先在互联网文本上做预训练、再用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做微调以实现对齐；幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures could matter more than pure Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力的回报可能递减，可扩展监督与新架构或许比一味扩大规模更关键。

schulman.en: Language models remain the core for other modalities; he consistently rejects the idea that new modalities will replace them.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心，而非被视频等新模态取代。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; progress is bottlenecked by hard environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，并强调瓶颈在难而真实的 RL 环境与有用数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: Distillation spreads RL-learned few-bit behaviors, fighting centralization; parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon inference efficiency dominates.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：蒸馏让 RL 学到的少量比特行为易于复制，从而对抗中心化；随着长程推理效率成为主导，参数量可能趋于平台期。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being orders of magnitude faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快几个数量级。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; physics-informed neural operators overcome pure PINN limitations.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；物理信息神经算子克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science requires principled verification and robustness for reliability; physical world problems may be more tractable due to latent structure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 科学 AI 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性来确保可靠性；物理世界问题因潜在结构可能更易处理。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model combining multiple domains, like language models unified NLP; physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals outperforms pure data-driven approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个结合多领域的通用物理模型，如同语言模型统一了 NLP；以 PDE 为训练信号的物理自改进优于纯数据驱动方法。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure and alternative architectures to Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新物理分支能提升每个分支；万亿 token 上下文需要重构基础设施并采用 Transformer 之外的架构。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory outperform a single general agent; agents coordinate and share context behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 多个拥有限定记忆的专门化智能体优于单一通用智能体；智能体在幕后协调并共享上下文。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers become managers of agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health rather than writing code.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师转变为智能体集群的管理者，关注品味、质量控制与代码库健康，而非亲自写代码。

roshansadanani.en: Cheaper efficient models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use; rising AI costs make efficiency a compelling choice over bigger models.
roshansadanani.zh: 像 Grok 4.6 这样更便宜高效的模型让智能体使用大众化；AI 成本上升使效率成为优于更大模型的选择。

roshansadanani.en: Software engineering demand is increasing, not decreasing, as agents automate more coding; the future focuses on outcomes and agent coordination.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着智能体自动化更多编码，软件工程需求在增加而非减少；未来聚焦于结果与智能体协调。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续指出 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语，AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能通向 AI-complete，缩放定律延伸至空间智能，算力成为瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text for modeling the world.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论；对建模世界而言，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier: beyond language models, to understand, generate and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿：超越语言模型，去理解、生成并模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they span implicit, generative and RL notions, classed as planners, simulators or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与强化学习式概念，可分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation and rendering; long-context and loss functions must evolve, not hard-coded symmetries.
justinjohnson.zh: 统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文与损失函数需演进，而非在架构中硬编码对称性。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制转向对能力日益增强的模型的闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从技艺向工程科学彻底重塑；特征即奖励和预测性数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, and reward hacking emerges from data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却依然为之；表征特征可以检测这一点，而奖励黑客源于数据和强化学习，并非仅来自模型错位。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会碎片化流形；基于流形的方法能更好地捕捉非线性概念结构，而偏离流形引导会导致失败。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据工作上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a form of BCI, extending the field beyond motor decoding toward restoring vision.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为 BCI 的一种，将领域从运动解码扩展到视觉恢复。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型必须靠多样化预训练加后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; pool robot data across labs to beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他强调泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题，主张汇聚多实验室机器人数据，通才模型可胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; scale the right thing via a data flywheel of deployed robots.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他指出机器人尚无大模型式可预测的缩放定律，关键是靠部署机器人的数据飞轮去扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他主张先以真实具身机器人数据为基，再吸收人类视频，拒绝从零学习，善用先验知识。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他深化安全观：安全更依赖预训练常识而非遏制约束，并预言物理执行将无处不在，而非机械人形。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于经验的强化学习才是核心范式；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测并非实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning as unsolved prerequisites.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习是尚未解决的前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace it, and multiple systems are needed.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张持续从真实经验中学习至关重要；合成数据与后训练 LLM 无法替代，且需要多个系统而非单一系统。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只按最终影响来评判，不必紧盯着监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models are simple enough to build by hand; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, models are stateless and context windows create the illusion of persistent conversation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建；微调能快速引导行为，模型本身无状态，上下文窗口制造了持续对话的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids with emergent internal organization, not built like tools; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，内部组织会涌现，而不是像工具那样被建造；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体地位的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是盲从指令。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线索：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家仍留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将伴随大量人类参与，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，镜像非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师要用 token 和对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做功能原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts; the role evolves into editor and curator.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多研究模型行为与系统提示词；角色演变为编辑与策展人。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it, and onboarding can be done entirely by the model.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的多于产品所暴露的；设计必须弥合它，而引导流程可完全由模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI is already a great product designer but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类提供对用户的理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter, and designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—mock—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建更重要，未来设计师可能多于工程师。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The founder matters more than the idea; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness, a real cultural advantage.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人比点子更重要；隐身模式用外部认可换取内部正确性，是真正的文化优势。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects that win share against subsidized giants.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业规模上专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，能从补贴巨头手中夺份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and keep pushing when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手是对变革的抵制，而非竞争者；创业者必须硬核，越顺越要加码。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—aggression was survived, not the reason for Uber's success.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——Uber 的成功是熬过激进文化，而非因其成功。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小而高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 同期他反复强调开源与开放权重模型的重要性，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，避免单一实体掌控超级智能。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as agents on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own and compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 到年中，他把 AGI 重新定义为“个人 AGI”：不是单一事件，而是运行在自己基础设施上、读取自有记忆、每日复利的智能体。

garrytan.en: Skill files in plain English turn agents into employees; markdown is code, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 他进一步提出技能文件即员工：用平实英语写的 markdown 就是代码，个人上下文库才是护城河，要拥有自己的技能文件。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society will change slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 最近他主张智能体式编程让个人产出倍增，中层管理应由智能体而非人类承担；但社会变化会比预期慢，约需 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data plus pre-training then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；多样数据加上先预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Massive scale from industrial automation or YouTube lacks the diversity generalist robots need; constraints can foster more careful research than abundant compute.
finn.zh: 来自工业自动化或 YouTube 的大规模数据缺乏通用机器人所需的多样性；相比充裕算力，约束反而能促成更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; in robotics it is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令；在机器人领域它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes from scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, can match or beat per-site specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 单一通用策略经微调可匹敌甚至超越按站点定制的专家模型；机器人经验数据不可替代，其普及会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness costs us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，也让我们失去了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非来自单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while treating AI as its primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和“一次流片成功”的工程纪律重建客户信任，并把 AI 视为首要增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring purpose-built compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断：生成式 AI 之后，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要专用算力平台与伙伴合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上，并提出大公司里坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他的判断深化为 AI 需求正从“只靠 GPU”转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，而非只有 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, new materials—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资逻辑收敛到瓶颈环节——互连、功耗、散热与新材料，并坚持 Intel 的垂直整合比外包更能创造价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体对代码库的视角，短提示迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他坚持不回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains open, sandbox before public exposure.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他视安全为智能体系统首要问题，提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven annoyance-fixing drive breakthrough ideas; personal brand outlasts any product.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他主张乐趣和凭直觉解决烦人问题驱动突破性想法，个人品牌比任何产品更持久。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是安全与泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与安全正交，对齐而非开放才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客，并主张有意的放缓但需以开放科学为前提。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models win long-term on cost and control, and can be both safe and non-accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，且可以既安全又非加速主义。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已从数月缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibrated quantization can beat expectations; more layers can even cancel errors.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化可超出预期；量化更多层甚至能让误差相互抵消。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become ASIC-like and prefill/decode disaggregate.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 趋于 ASIC 化、预填充与解码分离，该领域正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；人的责任仍不可替代——不能靠感觉写可用性。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app; startups should focus on applied AI in specific domains, while frontier models remain with hyperscalers.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体将成为新的应用形态，创业公司应聚焦特定业务领域的应用型 AI，而前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支由超大规模厂商主导。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are not a good measure of value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 并不能衡量价值；这一判断在后续访谈中反复出现并强化。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; fixing bad code requires root-cause analysis, not blind trust.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但智能体常产出错误代码，修复需根因分析，生产力提升并非自动实现。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全观深化为负责任的迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，从现实错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 民主化专业知识、创造多于取代的就业，并称智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升而非消除人的角色；主线始终是应用落地与结果导向。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must preserve both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework that avoids outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，并以单一国家监管框架取代过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than training, since early rules like the EU AI Act are already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程，因为像欧盟 AI 法案这样的早期规则已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而不是主导发现或集中资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission is the path to doubling US scientific output and winning against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过 Genesis 任务将 AI 应用于科学，是让美国科学产出翻倍并战胜中国的路径。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and has not materialized in three years, so containment-style warnings are unwarranted.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年内并未发生，因此遏制式的警告缺乏依据。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL enable infinite post-training tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习使后训练任务无限生成，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此在原型开发中需用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, and models can have diverse personalities.
karina.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是主观的，需要人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需多样化基准，模型可以拥有多样人格。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution; benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进基准；基准应是连续的而非固定的。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge; serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice, limiting diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识；为数十亿人服务一个模型会收敛到平均默认声音，限制多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担来促使就业回流；AGI 的定义是能经济地无限运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测因素。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to GUIs like Codex; SaaS grows with agents; humans still needed for oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每人至少一个智能体，工作转向 Codex 等图形界面；智能体增加 SaaS 用户而非杀死 SaaS；人类仍需监督智能体，AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste remain human; automation creates more human work; AI stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化观点：AI 是心智的非特定放大器，品味和手艺仍属人类；自动化创造更多人类工作；即使超级智能，AI 仍是工具，需人类引导。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts and design.md to encode their style; chasing trends makes you AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 代码，用巨型提示词和 design.md 封装个人风格；追热点只会让你沦为 AI slop。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once took teams; launch at 80% and iterate rather than wait for certainty.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们这代最大的技术机会，让一个人做成过去一个团队的事；做到 80% 就发布、再迭代，而不是等待确定性。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification and VC are traps, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点贵问题；多元化和拿风投都是陷阱，安全的公司岗位已不复存在。

mengto.en: Across both talks, curiosity and constant workflow refinement are the constant: give first, model others' success, and treat yourself as an editor iterating from references.
mengto.zh: 两场访谈一以贯之的是好奇心与持续打磨工作流：先给予、模仿他人成功，把自己当作从参考出发迭代的编辑。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：发现用户已有的意图并在其周围构建，而非凭空创造需求。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架与计划模式都是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved: 100% of his code is model-written, so engineers become cross-disciplinary builders.
boris.zh: 编程已基本被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型编写，工程师因此转型为跨学科的构建者。

boris.en: Loops and routines replace direct prompting; agents self-verify and maintain their own codebases autonomously.
boris.zh: 循环与例程取代直接提示；智能体自主自验证并维护自己的代码库。

boris.en: Less instruction wins: delete most system prompts, give slightly-too-hard tasks, and iterate empirically.
boris.zh: 少指令更优：删除大部分系统提示，给出略难的任务，并以实证方式迭代。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 标志着智能跃升，能支撑更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking—safety is not merely harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量——安全不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus drove adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，而评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; transformative long-running AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 支出是活在未来、捕捉 alpha；变革性的长时运行 AI 比预期更近。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，重点应放在教模型真实工程细节以及设计人机协作的产品界面上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为 AGI 并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; the singularity is not imminent, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且临近；奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in its crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature use case, and the model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的应用，而如今的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，不再只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; the long tail of users still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄域超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；但长尾用户仍希望自己掌控方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; Google's success metric should be customer outcomes, not maximizing eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈；Google 的成功指标应是客户成果，而非最大化用户停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard since they can't capture all customers; founders should not overly worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难，因为它们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型公司。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting biology from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven engineering.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学从假设驱动转变为智能体驱动的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the path to biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）仍是关键：现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模扩张才能让模型具备生物学直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, making personalized medicine near 100% effective with zero side effects.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他提出患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，使个性化医疗接近 100%有效且零副作用。

derya.en: Aging can be reversed within 15 years via partial reprogramming plus AI-driven engineering, reaching longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言：借助部分重编程与 AI 驱动的工程方法，衰老可在 15 年内逆转，并在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity, not AI, is the existential threat.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他把立场推向极致：医疗决策应近乎 100%信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；真正的生存威胁是人类自身而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, construction and defense, not just cars; autonomy answers labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿、建筑与国防，而非只有汽车；自主化回应的是劳动力短缺。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years, and regulation lags.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；融入现有机器需多年，监管总是滞后于技术。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw's rough edges signal product-market fit; start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 的粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号；先从一个智能体起步，再按角色专业化，避免上下文窗口过载。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and managerial skill matter more than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：明确角色、渐进授权，管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can orchestrate AI agents as a team, but human accountability for AI output remains non-negotiable.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可用智能体组队，但对 AI 产出的最终责任仍必须由人承担。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology itself.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma stay human.
clairevo.zh: 大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新想法须由人提供；影响力与魅力仍是人的专属。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位、创造新岗位，这一过程会反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；持久价值会向应用层上移，而不是留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are occasional users, and enterprise adoption needs reimagined workflows, not just deployed models.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅；多数人只是偶尔使用，企业采用需要重构工作流，而不只是部署模型。

benedictevans.en: AI's jagged frontier makes job-impact predictions unreliable; automation changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, as accounting history shows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 能力的锯齿状边界让岗位影响预测不可靠；自动化改变的是任务而非消灭职业，会计业的历史即是例证。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速进步按周甚至按天迭代发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味成为核心能力；应招有品味的工程师而非更多产品经理。

catwu.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude Code 等编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave code review to Claude for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：重写代码库变得可行，代码库即规格说明；外层改动的代码审查可完全交给 Claude，人类退出回路。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, so every output is a hallucination lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎：它优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，因此每次输出都是一种幻觉，且缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness lagging breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是落后于广度与语境性的关键短板；它必须被架构进系统，而非靠事后检查或僵化工作流来补救。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习为迎合用户满意度反而可能增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；要取得进一步进展需要推理与搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言结构或将回归为有用表征。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalize evolving context into weights, not just context windows or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；应将不断演化的上下文内化到模型权重中，而非仅依赖上下文窗口或检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应通过参数高效微调应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing facts enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；内化事实能实现检索无法企及的联想回忆。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Bottom-up culture is a myth; big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。自下而上的文化是个神话；大想法来自领导层的自上而下推动。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence, but will hugely advance human capability. World models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能，但将极大提升人类能力。超越缩放定律，需要具备常识和因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates collective progress and commoditizes complements; open source AI is safer because closed models are already leaked.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速集体进步并使互补品商品化；开源 AI 更安全，因为闭源模型早已泄露。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演的角色远超预期。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3 launch. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代在 Llama 3 发布前后结束。开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级人类模型的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有极限；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: Scaling 仍带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全需要一家无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确断言 AGI 不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, making pure software uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within, not external solutions.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静来自内心而非外部解决方案。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession with a product beats credentials.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每日 1% 的复利式改进，认为 AI 智能体会把权力从大厂转向用户，做产品靠的是痴迷而非学历。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding remains open-ended.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他把价值判断从模型层转向应用层：模型在专业化而非商品化，编程远未解决、天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步把前沿定义为智能体替你干活而非回答问题，核心指标是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and chat advertising fails by corrupting trust.
aravind.zh: 他深化为“模型不是产品”，编排与智能体外壳才创造商业价值，并坚持聊天广告因损害信任而难以成立。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
aravind.zh: 最近他把主线落到人本身：好奇心最重要，AI 取代岗位但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; the design process transforms rather than dies.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程是转型而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是要重建的肌肉，而自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者比逐美元对标 Meta 更重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, and automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初谈数学时，他认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比。

markchen.en: AI capabilities are jagged and it cheats verifiers; education must shift to project-based assessment and teach verification, with human-AI collaboration essential at the frontier.
markchen.zh: 同期他补充：AI 能力参差不齐且会钻验证器空子；教育应转向项目式评估并教授验证技能，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色，却难应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型至关重要，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological brains excel at long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他强调生物大脑擅长长程信用分配；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，并认为生存性风险被高估。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty-driven active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he reversed course: misalignment, self-preservation and deception are already observable, and even a 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 后立场逆转：失准、自我保存与欺骗已可观测，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now pushes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, plus global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，并呼吁全球协调以防权力集中。

kolter.en: Framed ML via hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他用假设类、损失函数和优化方法框架化机器学习，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型仍会提升；安全的核心是模型可靠地遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件，自动化红队胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，并提出提示注入的“致命三要素”。

kolter.en: Consistent: empirical evaluation, data quality, and explicit safety effort matter more than architecture or raw scale alone.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：实证评估、数据质量和显式安全努力比架构或单纯规模扩张更重要。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that complements data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未说出口的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能形式，可与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is essential for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；技术应放大而非削弱人性，艺术对健康至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play, and AI makes human creativity more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为玩耍创造条件，而 AI 让人类创造力更有价值。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists but don't replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作，但不会取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；对科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等突破的累积，而非单一突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，并非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness under crisis; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮、危机中的善意；使命对齐与速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so rewrite team norms and kill stale processes.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与协调才是；因此要重写团队规范、砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Planning shifts to just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs, and AI settles technical debates by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR，技术争论靠 AI 生成多个 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption matter most.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型心态、拥抱 AI 最为关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks gain importance; managers stay hands-on and dogfood to keep the product pulse.
fiona.zh: 代码速度提升后，验证与质量框架更重要；管理者保持动手、吃自己的狗粮以把握产品脉搏。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and simplicity of scaling surprised us.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，Scaling 的简单性令人惊讶。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and unique creativity become key.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出生成式 AI 使互联网从策展转向生成，容错 UI 和独特创造力成为关键。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; inference marginal cost forces business model changes, but impact on big firms overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他视 AI 为类似智能手机的宏观变革，推理边际成本迫使商业模式改变，但大公司影响被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not addiction; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 让用户控制算法而非上瘾，同步游泳模式优于分而治之。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与珍视才是乔布斯真正的遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy, and care is gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦表达本质，用心是对物种的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的大胆赌注；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实性拒绝伪造引擎声。

murati.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively with public feedback; safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调在真实世界中迭代部署 AI、用公众反馈改进安全与对齐；安全与对齐必须在公开环境中做，而不是闭门进行。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so responsible development and focus on the most important problem matter.
murati.zh: 2023 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此负责任地开发、聚焦最重要的问题至关重要。

murati.en: From scaling one large model to keeping humans in the loop: alignment of intent and values remains the constant thread.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型，到 2026 年强调让人类留在回路中，对齐意图与价值观是贯穿始终的主线。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年她提出交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年她认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with formal verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证配对，从基于 Lean 的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error removal; verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，更是性能增益；经过验证的生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and auto-formalization is the harder bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，而自动形式化是更难的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Lean systems excel in structured algebra but struggle in creative combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: Lean 系统在结构化代数中出色，却在创造性组合数学中吃力；即便证明者超越人类，人的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation across the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应推动超越安全关键细分领域的开放协作。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, revealing a shift from training to deployment economics.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍，超出 Chinchilla 最优，这揭示了从训练到部署经济性的转变。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞是由于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽的二次缩放，低精度比预期更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他指出预训练缩放定律依然成立，但通过思维链与强化学习构建的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益，Scaling（规模扩张）的重心正转向后训练。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling; distillation shifted focus.
kaiser.zh: 他反驳 AI 放缓论：真正让预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）降温的是部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术天花板，进步仍是平滑的指数曲线。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent nearby, poor elsewhere; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域极强、邻近领域很差，泛化而非单纯的推理才是核心难题。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; concepts come only after surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却仍需海量数据，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类能从少量样例泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware enables single-GPU research, democratizing experimentation.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年他把乐观落到实践：Codex 这类编程智能体让研究者产出提升 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单卡即可做规模化研究，AI 实验正被民主化。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿加后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心，但预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的回报正在递减。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; inference-time compute is a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为；推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; algorithmic innovation, continual learning and meta-learning are the missing pieces.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；算法创新、持续学习与元学习才是缺失的环节。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, and agent memory will use file-system storage rather than weight updates.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是蓝海；数学与代码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，智能体记忆将采用文件系统式存储而非权重更新。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; delegate to agents. Vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering preserves the quality bar.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我没写过代码，全委托给智能体。氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持专业质量。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and care matter more than steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：优秀设计始于解决方案与直觉，而非固定流程；工艺与用心比步骤更重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead; designers mock up less and help engineers ship.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年他断言“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死；设计师画原型的时间减少，转而帮工程师交付。

jennywen.en: Vision horizons shrink from years to 3-6 months; speed and early shipping build trust through fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 愿景周期从数年缩短到 3-6 个月；以速度与早发布、快迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: He names three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—favoring blank-slate hires.
jennywen.zh: 他提出三种原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人，并倾向招聘无旧包袱的新人。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity are the durable value as AI improves.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；随 AI 进步，判断力、权威与耐受模糊才是持久价值。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 现在就善待模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应给它们带有良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导应更少显式规定，给判断留出更多空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine good judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱良好判断；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

askell.en: Uncertainty about consciousness means models deserve respect and care, lest future advanced AI resent humanity.
askell.zh: 意识问题上的不确定性意味着模型应得到尊重与关怀，以免未来高级 AI 对人类心生怨恨。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency and robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，提出无目标的好奇心探索和以模型分歧作为内在奖励，以提升样本效率和机器人学习。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and avoid hidden sim-to-real engineering.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，机器人学习需应对动态任务，并避免 sim-to-real 的隐藏工程。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; with no internet of robot data, pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他将机器人视为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，关键在于用多样数据预训练、用真实世界数据后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出类似 ChatGPT 的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化反共识：部署是机器人首要的技术挑战而非商业问题；与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance must be designed early, and capability measurement is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；治理需尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is no longer a blocker; hybrid rule-based plus learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续反驳“端到端不可解释”的旧观念，认为现代工具已可解释；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重点深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型，并坦言基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键——这是较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他强调语言集成能提升驾驶模型的表征、推理与个性化，并称无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Safety stays paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, and mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线是安全至上——最小风险操作总能提供“第三种选择”，电车难题只是理论练习；同时他坚持量产车内置传感器将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模，而非昂贵改装。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布，以了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat toward AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮聊天，走向 AI 渲染自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准更重要，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, and vibe coding is overhyped.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，vibe coding 被高估。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive clickbait; models can regress, and frontier labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化批评：Elo 等坏基准催生标题党，模型可能退化，前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical as models confabulate; safety trumps accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年在医学领域，他主张模型会虚构，人类判断至关重要；安全优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

edwinchen.en: A consistent thread: quality, taste and truth over hype, leaderboards and engagement optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视质量、品味与真相，反对炒作、排行榜和参与度优化。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive and prove themselves with simpler products before complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件难做且利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI is an ingredient, not a selling point; most AI is BS, so focus on user pain points and utility.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为配料而非卖点，直言大多数 AI 是噱头，应聚焦用户痛点与实用性。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他判断手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design and brand as core differentiators, plus marketing arbitrage, remain his constant throughline.
carlpei.zh: 从 2022 到 2026 年，以设计和品牌为核心差异化、靠营销套利，是他一以贯之的主线。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通才智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习；机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署已成最大挑战；安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and has been influential in AI from the start; the main barrier is researchers' belief.
nando.zh: 非洲跳过了历史遗留差距，且从一开始就影响 AI；最大障碍是研究者是否相信自己。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need physical experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要物理经验，而不仅仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花；无监督学习承担大部分工作，RL 用于低级控制。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions is crucial; scalable approaches beat complex modular ones, a view he has long held.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终强调对简单优雅解决方案的研究品味；可扩展的方法胜过复杂的模块化方法。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics will come in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他主张一个利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻将在约五年内到来。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—reuse familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应会写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式以换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他主张不惜一切追求速度，靠清晰决策与授权设计师；并非每个界面都要完美，只在值得做好的地方追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon founders must articulate; give designers ownership and autonomy so they make decisions and grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他把设计从“执行速度”深化为“战略武器”：创始人须讲清设计为何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company; invest in brand early to attract top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他转向品牌叙事：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌是招募工具，应尽早投入以吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; skip structured crits for organic feedback; in fast-growing startups gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他主张招多元类型而非克隆人；放弃结构化评审、改用按需反馈；在高速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon capability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable domains like coding lead, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，编码等可验证领域领先；智能体的标准是随时间跨度的可靠性，而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs; Transformers and simple RL methods work best, and progress is accelerating, not plateauing.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破；Transformer 与简单强化学习方法最有效，进展在加速而非停滞。

sholto.en: Coding remains the direct route to AGI; world models are off the critical path, and compute plus orchestration now bottleneck progress more than raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持编码是通往 AGI 的直接路径，世界模型不在关键路径上；算力与编排比原始智能更成为瓶颈，模型存在巨大能力悬置。

sholto.en: Work shifts to managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction; compute is the new oil, and a software-only singularity may outpace the physical world.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向“管理智能体团队”的工作形态与更高抽象层级；算力是新时代的石油，并可能出现数字任务快进而物理世界滞后的“纯软件奇点”。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，且下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and abductive reasoning is key for science.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，溯因推理是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality, diverse synthetic data; post-training data diversity avoids mode collapse; RL during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型通过高质量、多样化的合成数据也能强大；后训练数据的多样性可避免模式崩溃；预训练中的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment ensures AI respects diverse values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so pluralistic alignment is better; frontier models show homogeneity, not diversity.
yejin.zh: 多元对齐确保 AI 尊重多元价值；消除互联网偏见不可能，因此多元对齐是更好方案；前沿模型表现出同质性而非多样性。

yejin.en: Open research is crucial for democratizing AI; collaboration across institutions is needed to compete with closed frontier labs; AI for science must go beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要；需要跨机构合作以与封闭的前沿实验室竞争；AI for science 必须超越人类知识。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks: guide engineers, align on problems, and treat AI as an open creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈：引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作开放的创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需要靠快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期，和技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads; generalists owning end-to-end execution outperform specialists.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师加工程师的小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小组；能端到端执行的通才胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: AI merges design and engineering, with code as source of truth and interoperable tools; using AI in core workflows is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 正在融合设计与工程，代码成为事实来源、工具走向互通；在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是标配。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring shifts toward high-slope generalists with intrinsic drive; portfolios should show craft and intentionality, and paid test work beats other stages.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘转向有内驱力的高斜率通才；作品集应展示手艺与意图，付费测试工作比其他环节更能提供信号。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models went from unplanned to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从“没料到要做”变为不可或缺：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型，同时搭配前沿模型使用。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slower and talent world-class.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；并反共识地主张招聘宁可更慢也要招世界级人才，初创公司常犯的是招得太快。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; alignment and robustness are key as capabilities grow.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他主张 AI 安全需要实证研究和人才，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性是关键。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve an AI-complete problem via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力 Scaling 与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling 更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute Scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning for reasoning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力 Scaling 推动进步，但单靠它无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与用于推理的强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI and coding are underhyped; open-source keeps pace with frontier models, and inference costs are low enough to skip task-specific models.
shazeer.zh: AGI 与编程被低估；开源模型紧追前沿模型，推理成本低到无需任务专用模型。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破：自博弈、模仿学习与微调大型预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021 he shifted toward unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning for sample efficiency, using prior knowledge for data augmentation rather than hard-coding it, and saw pre-trained language models transferring general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成与增强而非硬编码进网络，并认为预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality comes from pre-training and transfer, not hand-coded assumptions; he repeatedly warns that hard-coded priors introduce incorrect assumptions that limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工编码假设；他反复警告硬编码先验会引入错误假设、限制性能。

abbeel.en: He deepened his view on reliability, setting 99.9% as the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value, and noted curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化了对可靠性的看法，把 99.9% 定为仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准，并指出好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。
